messages:
Maya S.: FYI — kicking off RBAC roles schema refactor tomorrow 09:00 PT. Plan: add a new default role `service_writer` for service accounts, run a backfill in canary (10% orgs) then 10% rollout -> full. @Devin L. can you double-check KMS/key rotation interactions? audit logs must show grant_source=backfill for traceability.

Devin L.: On it. Quick Q: does the backfill script decrypt role blobs? If so we need to ensure it uses the live KMS key and we avoid the rotation window. We have a key rotation scheduled Friday — recommend delaying until +24h after rollout.

Samir R.: Reproduced a problem in staging: the backfill does SELECT FOR UPDATE then batch UPDATE, which escalated locks on roles table and timed out other requests. I changed it to read primary keys into a temp table and do small idempotent upserts by pk.

Ellie P.: Heads up — previous backfills produced duplicate audit events when retries happened. Make sure the backfill emits a single audit entry per grant and uses an idempotency token. Upsert WHERE NOT EXISTS helps.

Maya S.: Good catch. Samir, can you add an `idempotency_token` field and let the audit event include grant_source=backfill and the token. Also, add a feature-flag gate to disable role assignment quickly if something goes sideways. Rollback plan: disable flag + run script that queries audit log for grant_source=backfill and removes created grants.

Devin L.: Confirming KMS path: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rbac/cryptoKeys/rwd-rbac. Migration SA `rwd-migration-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` needs Cloud KMS CryptoKey Decrypt on that key. I'll postpone the automated key rotation until 24h after the full rollout window.

Samir R.: Pushed the idempotent upsert and token to staging. Snippet of the upsert we used:

```sql
-- idempotent grant upsert
INSERT INTO role_grants (principal_id, role, idempotency_token, created_at)
VALUES ($1, 'service_writer', $2, now())
ON CONFLICT (principal_id, role) DO UPDATE
SET idempotency_token = EXCLUDED.idempotency_token
WHERE role_grants.idempotency_token IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.idempotency_token;
```

Samir R.: Also added safe-skip: `WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_grants WHERE principal_id=$1 AND role='service_writer')` for the initial pass to avoid churn. Staging run: no duplicates, audit entries show grant_source=backfill + token.

Ellie P.: Please add monitoring dashboards: DB lock waits, write latency, and audit event rate for grant_source=backfill. Set an alert: if audit event rate for backfill > created_grants_threshold * 2 or DB lock wait 90th > 200ms, abort canary.

ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary deployment for rbac-backfill v2 at 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z (canary scope: 10% orgs).

Maya S.: Canary started. Samir, watch the backfill job logs and audit events. Devin, confirm KMS access for migration SA is functioning in prod. Ellie, we'll rely on your alerts. I'll post status updates every 30m for the first 2h. :eyes:

Samir R.: Canary halfway through first batch (~30min). Metrics: DB write IOPS +3%, lock waits +10ms, created grants 1,835 so far. No duplicate audit events observed. idempotency_token present in logs.

Devin L.: KMS checks passed. Migration SA decrypted blobs successfully in canary. No errors. I verified IAM binding for decrypt.

Ellie P.: Alerting: no alarms fired. Monitoring dashboards show minor IO bump, under threshold. Audit event rate matches created grants.

Maya S.: :thumbsup: rolling to next 10% cohort in 10m. If anything spikes, disable feature flag and run the cleanup script described earlier.

audit-bot: backfill-run completed for cohort=10% at 2026-03-25T10:12:03Z; grants_created=1835; duplicates_detected=0; avg_db_write_latency_ms=4.7

Samir R.: Post-canary note: fixed an edge-case where external service accounts with stale metadata caused the upsert to retry — added a pre-check to skip invalid principals. Will schedule the remaining rollouts tomorrow morning.
